correctness.rationale: Stationary resource flux gives (c+e)p_m+kq_m=c. Regenerative resource-occupied episodes with independent individual on/off chains yield L_m=integral exp(-et)s(t)^m dt and p_m=cL_m/(1+cL_m), q_m=c(1-eL_m)/(k(1+cL_m)). For all t>0 s(t) in (0,1), hence L_m strictly decreases, q_m strictly increases, and sign law follows. Feynman-Kac yields log s(t)=-uk t^2/2+O(t^3), with dominated rescaling and exponentially suppressed tail proving L_m~sqrt(pi/(2muk)). All rates positive and m integer>=0; threshold equality is exact, not an invalid asymptotic to zero.

value.rationale: A model-specific but natural exact all-guild-size sign phase and limiting richness quantify when adding specialized consumers stabilizes or inhibits counted diversity. The strict q_m ordering is an essential nontrivial consequence of regenerative killing, and the sharp m^-1/2 approach is not an elementary restatement of stationary flux.

final_claim: For one basal resource and m exchangeable independent specialists in a finite CTMC, stationary total richness S_m has sign(S_{m+1}-S_m)=sign(c+e-k), equality S_m=c/(c+e) at k=c+e, and S_m-c/k~[c(k-c-e)/k]sqrt(pi/(2mku)) for k != c+e.
